intro:
Dear Graduates,
Greetings of Perseverance and Selfless Service!
We kindly request you to complete this Graduate Tracer Survey (GTS) Questionnaire as accurately and honestly as possible by checking (✓) the box corresponding to your response or providing the necessary information.
Your responses will be used for research purposes to assess graduate employability, enhance course offerings in your alma mater, and support other universities and colleges across the Philippines in improving academic programs. .
This survey is intended for all graduates from the years 2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, and 2024.  
IMPORTANT INSTRUCTIONS
Please use capital letters when typing your answers.
If a section or question is not applicable to you, please indicate "N/A
All information you provide will be handled with the strictest confidentiality and used only for statistical and research purposes
